identificationModule.briefTitle: Safety Study of VM202 to Treat Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I/II, Open Label Study to Assess the Safety and Tolerability of VM202 in Subjects With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to determine the safety and tolerability of intramuscular injections of VM202 at different injection sites in people with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
